_note: Lansing State Journal Greater Lansing Dream Team and all-area teams (Jack Norman, from LSJ clippings). Separate from all-conference and all-state. Only schools the site covers are kept; each season keeps counts of the full list. team: poy (LSJ Player of the Year), dream (Dream Team), first/second/hm (for years the all-area team is tiered), area (an untiered all-area team), coy (Coach of the Year; division coaches use coy with a division). division: the all-area team's division or class when the LSJ splits it; blank for Player of the Year and Dream Team. grade: 9-12 as printed. name uses the site's spelling; listed_as keeps the LSJ spelling when different.

seasons.teams_note: Player of the Year, a nine-player Dream Team and Coach of the Year across all divisions, then an untiered all-area team and coach for each of Divisions 1-4.
seasons.left_out: One Dream Team pick and the overall Coach of the Year (both Pewamo-Westphalia), and all-area picks from schools the site doesn't cover, including every Division 3 and 4 pick.
